# Sonos

Every app in this list that runs on Sonos. That is 1 apps with 1 for Plex and 0 for Jellyfin and 0 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Official apps

- [Plex on Sonos](https://support.sonos.com/services/plex) - Plex music service inside the Sonos app and on Sonos speakers. `Plex` · `Sonos` · `Free`
